api.name: Timeseries API
api.description: This API returns information about Timeseries metadata and datapoints.
api.apiVersionDescription: Link to be attached to “API change history” for this API. https://github.com/equinor/OmniaPlant/blob/master/Omnia%20Timeseries%20API/CHANGELOG.md

operations.name: Adds or updates a timeseries' datapoints.

templateParameters.name: id
templateParameters.description: Format - uuid. Id of timeseries for which to add or update datapoints

operations.description: Adds or updates a timeseries' datapoints.

queryParameters.name: async
queryParameters.description:
Determines whether the datapoints should be written asynchronoulsy. 
            If you set this to false, the request will not be returned until the changes are fully committed.
            If you set this to true or do not supply it, the write will be enqueued and the request will return 202 Accepted.

operations.name: Retrieves aggregated datapoints by id from a given time window and applied parameters.

templateParameters.name: id
templateParameters.description: Format - uuid. Id of timeseries from which to retrieve data.

templateParameters.name: aggregateFunction
templateParameters.description: Aggregation to apply to processing bins. Multiple simultaneous functions supported. Available values: [avg, min, max, sum, stddev, count, first, last, median]

operations.description: Retrieves aggregated datapoints by id from a given time window and applied parameters.

queryParameters.name: processingInterval
queryParameters.description: The binning-interval for the aggregation. Must be smaller than total window size. If not given, then the aggregations are performed acrosss the entire time window. E.g. 1s, 5m, 10h, 20d.

queryParameters.name: startTime
queryParameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). Start of data window

queryParameters.name: endTime
queryParameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). End of data window

queryParameters.name: status
queryParameters.description: Filters on status value(s) if given.Should only be used when necessary due to performance penalty.Documentation of status codes https://github.com/equinor/OmniaPlant/wiki/Timeseries-Data

queryParameters.name: fill
queryParameters.description: Determines how to fill empty bins. Available values: [null, none, forward, linear]. Default is none.

queryParameters.name: limit
queryParameters.description: Format - int32. Limit of datapoints pr page in the result set. Between 1-100 000. For next page use continuationToken.

queryParameters.name: continuationToken
queryParameters.description: The continuationToken for next result set.

queryParameters.name: federationSource
queryParameters.description: Determines whether or not the request should use federation as data source.
